marketing_wrapper: Light. A plain white backdrop, a hand-lettered 'grug.' wordmark at the bottom and faint oversized scribbles (flower, arrow, 'Life' sign) bleeding behind the frame. 01 is a frameless intro card (sun drawing plus four lines of grug-speak), likely the app's own onboarding screen. 02-06 show the main screen in a modern iPhone frame at about 65%. Even the status bar time and battery are drawn in the hand-lettered style, so the status bar is a marketing mock-up, not the real system bar.

typography.display: Custom hand-lettered (handwriting-style) face used for everything: wordmark, wisdom text, dates, nav labels. Lower-case only. Name unsure; looks like a font made from the maker's own handwriting.
typography.weights: Single weight throughout; hierarchy comes from size and position only.
typography.case_and_tracking: All lower-case, including the wordmark and the deliberately broken grammar ('grug share one small wisdom'); normal tracking with generous line height.

palette.accent_strategy: Per-content, two colours per day: each daily wisdom gets one flat background and one matching ink colour (black on white, cream on forest green, dark teal on sky blue, maroon on mint, orange on near-black navy). The ink colour also fills the small dot top-right. No gradients, no other accents.
palette.source: palette.json 02 (#ffffff, #000000), 03 (#00483c), 04 (#7dcafe), 05 (#c7f6e4), 06 (#090818); ink colours are visual estimates because the lines are thin

shape.radius_language: none drawn by code: shapes are hand-drawn wobbly lines; the share control is a hand-drawn oval
shape.materials: Flat solid colour fields; line drawings.

density: low: one drawing, three to five lines of text and a date per screen, with large empty space
layout: Top: 'grug.' wordmark left, a small ink dot right. Centre: one hand-drawn picture (sun, flower, heart with arrow, 'Life' sign, smiling bag) or an empty area with 'you draw for grug' and an arrow. Lower: the day's wisdom in grug-speak and 'grug. <date>'. Bottom: a horizontal row of previous/next days, each a tiny drawn icon (sprout, hut, fire, rock, moon) with its date, around a central drawn oval share button with a smiling up-arrow.
navigation: Fully custom: no tab or nav bar. A day strip at the bottom acts as navigation between daily wisdoms; 'grug back sun rise' marks the next locked day.
imagery_and_icons: Hand-drawn scribble illustrations and a hand-drawn icon set (sprout, hut, fire, rock, moon, asterisk), outline only; one drawing per day. The 'you draw for grug' state suggests user drawings.
signature_visual_move: Every pixel is drawn by hand (type, icons, share button, even the mocked status bar), and each day swaps to a new flat two-colour pairing.

direction_fit.why: One maker's hand is the governing asset across type, icons and drawings. The one-wisdom-per-day strip with locked future days ('grug back sun rise') is a light time constraint, hence Rationed Ritual as secondary.

notes: Identity confirmed: seller Ocho B.V., version 1.5.3; scribbled hand-drawn design with daily Neanderthal-speak wisdom, matching the 2026 ADA Delight and Fun winner. No account, sign-in or sync UI appears in any frame, which fits 'no login' but cannot prove it. Navigation is custom, which goes against the Authored Illustration rule 'navigation stays native'; for grug that rule does not hold.
